name: 离散型 EWM – 入库处理 (4RO)
description_en_html:
Overview

In this scope item, products that are delivered with the intent to be stored in the warehouse are received and moved to a storage bin. This process allows different variants of inbound processing such as an inbound from supplier and inbound from other storage locations. The process starts with an inbound delivery that is relevant for processing in the warehouse. Once the products arrive at the warehouse, batches can be assigned to the inbound delivery items. Afterwards, the goods receipt is posted, and warehouse tasks are created to execute the movements in the warehouse. After moving the products to the final bin or the clarification zone (exceptional case), the warehouse tasks are confirmed accordingly.

Key Process Flow

  • Assign or create batch (optional)
  • Change stock type (optional)
  • Create handling unit and print label (optional)
  • Post goods receipt
  • Create putaway warehouse tasks and print putaway lists
  • Confirm warehouse tasks
  • Check material in clarification zone (optional)
  • Create warehouse tasks from clarification zone to final bin and print warehouse task lists (optional)
  • Confirm warehouse tasks (optional)

Business Benefits

  • Receive products from different sources and store them in your warehouse
  • Control and record movements of products and handling units in the warehouse
  • Map your warehouse complex in the system down to storage bin level
  • Improve visibility and control in warehouse operations
  • Handle exceptions
  • Work with batches
description_zh_html:
概览

在此范围项目中，接收为了存储在仓库中而交付的产品并将其移动到仓位。此流程允许入库处理的不同变式，例如来自供应商的入库和来自其他存储地点的入库。该流程从与仓库中的处理相关的入库交货开始。产品到达仓库后，可以将批次分配到入库交货项目。之后，过账收货，并创建仓库任务以执行仓库中的移动。将产品移动到最终仓位或澄清区域（例外情况）后，将相应地确认仓库任务。

关键流程流

  • 分配或创建批次（可选）
  • 更改库存类型（可选）
  • 创建处理单元并打印标签（可选）
  • 过账收货
  • 创建入库仓库任务并打印入库清单
  • 确认仓库任务
  • 检查澄清区域中的物料（可选）
  • 创建从澄清区域到最终仓位的仓库任务并打印仓库任务清单（可选）
  • 确认仓库任务（可选）

业务优势

  • 接收来自不同货源的产品，并将其存储在仓库中
  • 控制和记录仓库中产品和处理单元的移动。
  • 将系统中的综合仓库映射到仓位级别。
  • 提高仓库运营的可见性和控制
  • 处理异常
  • 使用批次
